name: Locale Provider
purpose: Supply an inherited locale, logical direction, and overridable Brick-authored interface text without becoming the application translation runtime.
useWhen: A Brick subtree needs shared number formatting, logical direction, or localized component-owned labels.

avoidWhen.condition: Product copy, pluralization, routing, or message loading needs translation.

composition: Mount once near the application or route root and keep translated Block content in application-owned data.

rules.statement: Mount LocaleProvider at an application boundary rather than inside each Block.
Use localeText only for generic Brick-authored accessibility labels; keep product copy in the application message catalog.
Load styles.css or core.css plus locale-provider.css.

commonMistakes.mistake: Shipping translations inside a reusable Block.
commonMistakes.correction: Expose replaceable content and let the application select translated messages.

validation: Verify locale inheritance, RTL direction, explicit component-label precedence, nested providers, and deterministic server output.
